mapper.select: select user_id, nickname from users where nickname like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' and del_yn = 'N' and user_id <> #{excludeUserId} order by nickname fetch first 20 rows only
select nickname from users where user_id = #{userId} and del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: insert into trip_member (trip_id, user_id, role, status) values (#{tripId}, #{userId}, #{role}, 'INVITED')
mapper.select: select m.trip_id, m.user_id, u.nickname, m.role, m.status from trip_member m join users u on m.user_id = u.user_id where m.trip_id = #{tripId} and u.del_yn = 'N' order by case m.role when 'OWNER' then 1 when 'EDITOR' then 2 when 'VIEWER' then 3 else 4 end, u.nickname

select m.trip_id, t.title, o.nickname as owner_nickname, m.role from trip_member m join trip t on t.trip_id = m.trip_id join trip_member om on om.trip_id = m.trip_id and om.role = 'OWNER' join users o on o.user_id = om.user_id where m.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = 'INVITED' and t.del_yn = 'N' order by m.trip_id desc

select m.trip_id, t.title, o.nickname as owner_nickname, m.role from trip_member m join trip t on t.trip_id = m.trip_id join trip_member om on om.trip_id = m.trip_id and om.role = 'OWNER' join users o on o.user_id = om.user_id where m.trip_id = #{tripId} and m.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = 'INVITED' and t.del_yn = 'N'
